swimming_pool.evidence: A round above-ground pool-like structure with a green-tinted water surface and a lighter rim sits at the lower left of center, partly shaded by trees. It is roughly 20% of the way in from the lower left and may belong to a neighboring lot.

detached_structure.evidence: A small dark-roofed structure sits beside the pool near the bottom center, and a dark-roofed building is visible just above the central tree canopy. Which lot each belongs to is unclear.

signals.notes: The central lot is mostly hidden under dense mature tree canopy, so the house and roof cannot be assessed. A round green-water above-ground pool is visible to the lower left, and neighboring roofs are visible at the left and right.
